description: Statically checks event command lists in map events, common events and troop pages. Rules: unterminated-list and block-structure (missing code 0 terminator, unclosed or mismatched choices/branches/loops, indent jumps; error), unreachable-command (a command right after Exit Event Processing at the same indent; warning), long-message-line (a Show Text line too long for the window; warning), transfer-missing-map and transfer-out-of-bounds (direct Transfer Player to a map not in MapInfos or outside its size; error), missing-common-event (Common Event call to an id that does not exist; error), unnamed-switch and unnamed-variable (Control Switches/Variables on ids with no name in System.json; info). Variable-designated transfers are not checked. long-message-line removes message control codes (\C[n], \V[n], \N[n], \P[n], \I[n], \{ \} \. \| \! \> \< \^) and compares the remaining character count with maxLineChars; the default of 50 is only an approximation, since real fit depends on the font, face graphic and window width. Findings carry location {kind, mapId, eventId, page, index}; page and index are 0-based positions in the event's pages and command list (common events use page 0, troops use the troop id as eventId). minSeverity defaults to warning, so info findings appear only when requested. scope defaults to all; mapId limits the map part to one map. Maps whose file cannot be read are listed in skippedMaps. Results are sorted by severity then location and capped at 300 findings; counts cover all findings and truncated is the number cut.

mapId.description: Lint only this map (affects the maps part of the scope).

maxLineChars.description: Longest allowed Show Text line after control codes are removed (approximate).

name: lint_events
title: Lint event command lists
